knownDebt.reason: Generated artifact: `pnpm run gen:schema` (scripts/generate-permissions-schema.ts) rewrites this file and then runs `biome format --write`, whose default indentation is tabs, while upstream ships 2-space. The tab indentation is produced by the generator, not by hand-reformatting; re-running gen:schema re-applies it.

wrapper-analysis.ts exports innerCommandIndex with an optional allowEmpty=false parameter in getoptInnerIndex while retaining upstream getoptWalkEnd and no-command proof; fork sudo/env/xargs/doas classification reuses that grammar, rejects refused or computed wrapper-layer words, and preserves legal payload-less calls where the wrapper runs nothing; recognized chains retain sudo floors and explicit inner denies

wrapper-floors.ts marks shell-template wrappers and uncertain dynamic or getopt argument shapes unresolved in both modes, preserving upstream's safety boundary without losing safe fallback inner-unit gating; xargs without an explicit command stays floored because it can run implicit echo

program-declared-effects.test.ts expects the fork's extra wrapper_indirection unit without changing upstream's declaration-isolation assertion; program and bash-command tests preserve fork inner units and explicit inner denies alongside upstream wrapper safety
permission-events.ts extends the fork-only forwarded-decision resolution union with upstream prompt_unanswered, preserving both timeout reporting and the serving-session scope
measure-core-coverage.mjs reports malformed or unreadable declaration files with a caused error instead of leaving JSON.parse unguarded; failures remain nonzero
bash-command.test.ts expects explicit inner rm denies to outrank the outer floor for correctly parsed sudo --user/-nu cases; program.test.ts keeps refused sudo compound syntax unresolved
